messages.subject: Storing reactive input in vector
parts:
Dear all,

Thank you for the Shiny package! In my opinion it is very useful. However, I experience some difficulties.

I would like to combine the input the user gives in a vector. Depending on the input of the user I create a number of "numericInput" fields, so the user can choose to enter 2 but also 20 values. In the next step, I want to combine these inputs in a vector to use further on in the analyses.

My code:

  output$dyn_input <- renderUI({
    inputs <- lapply(1:input$n, function(i) {
      input_name  <- paste("Correlation study", i, sep=" ")
      
      numericInput(input_name, label = input_name, value = 0, min = -1, max = 1)
      
      })
    
    do.call(tagList, inputs)
  })

input$n refers to the number of "numericInput" fields.

Of course I can combine the input with: "object <- c(input$"Correlation study 1", input$"Correlation study 2")" in case of only two values entered by the user, but this becomes problematic when the user enters for instance 10 values.

A highly similar question was asked before (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/3KEjXnW1oWY), but without replies.

Thank you in advance for your help!
